description_en: Creates and deploys a service instance in Compute Nest by specifying parameters such as a region ID, a service instance name, and a service ID
description_zh: 通过配置地域ID、服务实例名称、服务 ID等参数，在计算巢中创建并部署服务实例
kebab_example: aliyun computenest create-service-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id service-0e6fca6a51a544200000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateServiceInstance

parameters.help_en:
The region ID. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou).

ap-southeast-1: Singapore
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。可能的值：

cn-hangzhou：华东1（杭州） 。

ap-southeast-1：新加坡
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the service instance. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name can be up to 64 characters in length.

It must start with a letter or a digit and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例名称。格式要求如下：

长度不超过64个字符。

必须以数字或英文字母开头，可包含数字、英文字母、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The service ID
parameters.help_zh: 服务ID
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The service version
parameters.help_zh: 服务版本
parameters.name: service_version

parameters.help_en:
The parameters for deploying the user instance.

If the service instance contains deployment region information, you must specify the region in the deployment parameters
parameters.help_zh:
用户实例部署的参数。

若服务实例包含部署地域信息，需在部署参数中填写
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: A client-generated, unique token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the service instance has the O\&M feature. Valid values:

true: The service instance has the O\&M feature.

false: The service instance does not have the O\&M feature
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例是否有代运维功能。取值范围：

true：服务实例有代运维功能。

false：服务实例没有代运维功能
parameters.name: enable_instance_ops

parameters.help_en: The template name. You must specify this parameter if the service supports multiple templates
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称，服务支持多模板时需要指定模板名称
parameters.name: template_name

fields.help_en: The end time of the O\&M window. This parameter is valid only in managed O\&M mode
fields.help_zh: 运维结束时间，只在纯代运维模式下有效
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: Additional information about the managed O\&M service
fields.name: extra_info

fields.help_en: The ID of the imported service instance
fields.name: service_instance_id

fields.help_en: The start time of the O\&M window. This parameter is valid only in managed O\&M mode
fields.help_zh: 运维开始时间，只在纯代运维模式下有效
fields.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The O\&M configuration
parameters.help_zh: 代运维配置
parameters.name: operation_metadata

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The CloudMonitor alert contact group that receives alerts
parameters.help_zh: 接收告警的云监控联系人组
parameters.name: contact_group

parameters.help_en:
The type of the service instance. Valid values:

Trial: The service instance supports trial.

NotTrial: The service instance does not support trial
parameters.help_zh:
当前服务实例的类型。可选值：

Trial：支持试用。

NotTrial：不支持试用
parameters.name: trial_type

parameters.help_en: The custom tags
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The name of the specification package
parameters.help_zh: 套餐规格名称
parameters.name: specification_name

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to perform a dry run for the request. The dry run checks for permissions and instance status. Valid values:

true: Sends the request without creating the service instance.

false: Sends the request and creates the service instance after the check is passed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。可能的值：

true：发送请求，不创建服务实例。

false：发送请求，检查通过后创建服务实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The commodity specification code
parameters.help_zh: 商品规格码
parameters.name: specification_code

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to enable Prometheus monitoring. Valid values:

true: Enable.

false: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用Prometheus监控，可能的值：

true：启用。

false：不启用
parameters.name: enable_user_prometheus

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether to enable automatic payment for the order. Valid values:

true: Enable automatic payment.

false: Disable automatic payment
fields.help_zh:
订单是否自动支付。取值：

true：自动支付。
false：不自动支付
fields.name: auto_pay

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: Enable.

false: Disable
fields.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false：不开启
fields.name: auto_renew

fields.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

Year: Year.

Month: Month.

Day: Day
fields.help_zh:
购买时间单位，取值：

Year：年。

Month：月。

Day：日
fields.name: pay_period_unit

fields.help_en: The ID of the private offer in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace
fields.name: quotation_id

parameters.help_en: The information about the Alibaba Cloud Marketplace purchase order. You do not need to specify this parameter if the service is not listed in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace or if you use the pay-as-you-go billing method
parameters.help_zh: 云市场购买订单信息，服务未上云市场或按量计费不必传
parameters.name: commodity

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to automatically deduct the payment from your account balance. Valid values:

true: Enable automatic payment.

false: Disable automatic payment
parameters.help_zh:
资源是否自动从余额中扣款支付。取值：
true：自动支付。
false：不自动支付
parameters.name: resource_auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service instance to convert to a paid instance
parameters.help_zh: 需转正式的服务实例id
parameters.name: service_instance_id

MarketInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Marketplace instance

Status.description_en:
The status of the service instance. Valid values:

Created: The service instance is created.

Deploying: The service instance is being deployed.

DeployedFailed: The service instance failed to be deployed.

Deployed: The service instance is deployed.

Upgrading: The service instance is being upgraded.

Deleting: The service instance is being deleted.

Deleted: The service instance is deleted.

DeletedFailed: The service instance failed to be deleted
Status.description_zh:
服务实例状态。取值：

Created：已创建。

Deploying：部署中。

DeployedFailed：部署失败。

Deployed：已部署。

Upgrading：升级中。

Deleting：删除中。

Deleted：已删除。

DeletedFailed：删除失败
